caveats: Technical integration candidate only; approved remains false.
Eight initial source roles are required; exact PNG originals remain unchanged. No source pixel editing or per-part rescaling.
Fixed anatomical density per direction, all parts scale1, measured source joints and sole pivots.

FRONT uses semantic foreground polygons to keep actual front armor/tabard/shield/sword ahead of legs while the broad ivory cape stays behind. BACK uses natural rear cape occlusion with default depth; RIGHT uses semantic rig foreground polygons.

RIGHT five-part IK retains one visible knee/ankle per leg, fixed two-foot center and complete boots. Side-view hidden hip and knee-cap landmarks are approximate; slight stance/projection height difference remains an art caveat, not exact bone-length proof.

Native eight-frame side attack retains original pixels, row-major crops and125ms timings, fixed reference340, and one first-neutral portrait-aligned anchor[247.75,431] for all frames. LEFT uses canonical mirror.
Final artwork consistency and continuous gait acceptance remain pending.

RIGHT versus FRONT: the side-profile candidate stands about16-20 rendered px taller at the common foot baseline. If the manually marked hip/knee points are homologous, normalized thigh length is about25% longer and shin about20% longer. Armor occlusion and IK projection make those landmarks uncertain; visual review did not establish a mandatory regeneration, but three-direction anatomical equivalence is not claimed.
